# Synthetic equipment desk

2025-01-11

## Cover loan

Record RNT-213. Return the canopy by noon on the next business day.
A cleaning fee applies when the canopy comes back muddy.
Cloths are kept in drawer G.

## Strap supply

Record SUP-419. Replacement straps are stocked in bin H.

## Locker log

Record LOG-517. Never write an apartment number.
Put unclaimed gloves in tray D.

## Unrelated stock

Record ENV-904. Spare cardboard cartons are in the loading bay.
Light shelves are labeled in alphabetical order.
